newsitem.title: CHINA: China economy seen rising 10 pct for 1997.
newsitem.headline: China economy seen rising 10 pct for 1997.

text.p: China's economy is expected to soar by 10 percent this year and to grow by 9.4 percent in the third quarter compared with the year-ago period, the Financial News said on Tuesday.

Gross domestic product for the whole year was forecast to reach 7.98 trillion yuan while the figure for the third quarter was seen at 1.8 trillion yuan, it said, quoting a forecast by the State Economic and Trade Commission.
Primary industry was expected to grow by 5.0 percent in the third quarter and by a similar figure for the whole year, it said.

Secondary industry would increase by 11 percent for the third quarter and 12 percent for the year while tertiary industry would rise by 8.5 percent in the third quarter and 9.0 percent for the year, it said.
The economy would continue to grow steadily with efficiency continuing to improve, it said. China's economy grew by 9.5 percent year-on-year for the first half.
China's economy grew by 9.8 percent last year.
It forecast industrial output would rise 12 percent in the third quarter. Industrial output grew 11.6 percent year-on-year in the first half and by 12.0 percent for June alone.

Fixed asset investment was expected to grow by 17 percent for the whole year to 2.8 trillion yuan, or by more than 10 percent after inflation, it said. It was seen growing by 15 percent in the third quarter to 414 billion yuan, it said.
